sign_in.step_description: Navigate to https://www.nike.com and sign in using the account credentials. Steps: (1) Navigate to https://www.nike.com. Wait 3 seconds for the page to load. (2) Look for a sign-in link or icon (typically 'Join Us / Sign In', a profile icon, or similar). Click it to open the login form or navigate directly to https://www.nike.com/login. (3) On the login page, enter email 'happyautoec@outlook.com' in the email field, click Continue or Next. (4) Nike may present one of two challenge screens: (a) If the page shows a 'Use Password' or 'Sign in with password' button, click it to switch to password login. (b) If the page shows an email verification code input (e.g. 'Enter the code sent to your email'), call get_email_verification_code action with not_before set to the Unix timestamp (seconds) captured just before you clicked Continue/Next in step (3) — this ensures only the freshly-sent code is matched, not any older codes in the inbox. Set timeout_seconds=60. Then type the returned code into the input field and submit. (5) Enter password 'Happy@1234' in the password field (if on password screen) and click Sign In. (6) Wait up to 10 seconds for login to complete. Handle any intermediate screens: CAPTCHA prompts (stop and report), 'Stay signed in' dialogs (click Yes/Confirm). (7) Verify login succeeded by checking for a user account icon, profile name, or 'Hi, [name]' greeting. If login failed (error message visible), report the failure and stop.
sign_in.expected_result: User should be successfully signed in to Nike. Page should show account icon or greeting indicating authenticated state. No error messages about incorrect credentials.

handle_cart.step_name: Navigate to cart page and handle cart items
handle_cart.step_description: Navigate to Nike cart page (https://www.nike.com/cart). IMPORTANT: After navigation, wait 3 seconds for the page to load completely, then extract the page content again to get the actual cart state (the initial page load may show incorrect cart count). Then handle cart items based on their actual status: (1) First, if there are any items marked as 'Sold Out', 'Not Available', 'Out of Stock', or similar unavailable status, remove ALL these unavailable items by clicking their remove/delete buttons. (2) After removing unavailable items (if any), check if cart still has valid items remaining. If YES (cart has at least one valid item that can be checked out), proceed to next step. (3) If NO (cart is empty after removing unavailable items, or was empty from the start), then find ONE product that is AVAILABLE (NOT showing 'Coming Soon', 'Not Available', 'Out of Stock', or 'Sold Out'), add ONLY this one item to cart, then return to cart page (https://www.nike.com/cart) and wait 5 seconds to verify the item was added successfully.
handle_cart.expected_result: Cart page should show at least one valid item ready for checkout. All unavailable items should have been removed. Cart is ready to proceed to checkout.

navigate_to_checkout.step_description: From the cart page with valid items, proceed to checkout by clicking the checkout button or navigate directly to https://www.nike.com/checkout. Wait 3 seconds after navigation for the page to fully load. NOTE: If signed in, Nike may skip the guest email entry step and land directly on the shipping address or payment page — any of these is acceptable.
navigate_to_checkout.expected_result: Should successfully reach checkout page at https://www.nike.com/checkout with cart items loaded. Page may show email input (guest), shipping address form, saved-address selection, or payment section.

init_log_monitor.step_description: Initialize log file monitor to track autofill status changes from Edge logs. ONLY do this if you haven't initialized it yet in previous steps.
init_log_monitor.expected_result: Log monitor should be initialized successfully

trigger_autofill_popup.step_description: Identify the first editable input field suitable for autofill. Priority order: (1) email field (if visible, i.e. guest checkout), (2) first name or last name field in the shipping address form, (3) street address field, (4) any other visible text input in the shipping or billing section. Once identified: clear the field by typing empty string with clear=true, wait 0.5 seconds. Then use cdp_click to click the field ONCE (cdp_click automatically manages window focus), wait 2 seconds, and call uia_wait_for_popup (timeout: 5 seconds) to detect the autofill popup. If popup detection fails, use os_click as backup: perform os_click on the same field ONCE, wait 2 seconds, then call uia_wait_for_popup again (timeout: 5 seconds). NOTE: If a field is pre-filled, clear it first before clicking.
trigger_autofill_popup.expected_result: The selected field should be cleared and focused. Edge's Express Checkout autofill popup should appear and be detected by UIA (popup visible, regardless of option count).

uia_click_autofill.step_description: Use uia_select_autofill action to click the first autofill option in the detected popup. This should trigger the autofill process to fill all form fields.
uia_click_autofill.expected_result: UIA should successfully click the autofill button, and form fields (email, firstName, lastName, address, etc.) should be automatically filled

wait_autofill_log.step_name: Wait for autofill completion via log monitor
wait_autofill_log.step_description: Use log monitor to wait for checkout state 'AutofillSucceeded' from the Edge log file with a timeout of 30 seconds. This confirms that autofill has completed successfully
wait_autofill_log.expected_result: Log file monitor should detect state 'AutofillSucceeded' indicating the autofill operation completed successfully

test_cases.test_case_description: Navigate to Nike checkout page as guest, trigger autofill popup, and click autofill button. Preconditions: Edge browser has at least one saved address

Sign in to Nike with a registered account, then navigate to checkout and trigger autofill popup. Preconditions: Edge browser has at least one saved address. Account: happyautoec@outlook.com / Happy@1234
